title: Can You Make a Tongue CLOVER? ☘️
description:
Stick your tongue out, roll it, then flip the tip up. Got a taco instead of a clover? Join the club: in a 2020 study of 374 adults, only about 1 in 7 (14.7%) could make the cloverleaf, the hardest of five tongue tricks tested, while 83.7% could roll. Every tongue has the same muscles, running lengthways, across and up and down, but the nerve wiring differs from person to person, and scientists suspect that is part of why some tongues are gymnasts.
Taco, clover or flat?

Bonus: in that study the clover people could also do most of the other tongue tricks (rolling, folding, twisting). Show-offs.

Next up: why can't you say M with your mouth OPEN?

Subscribe for a new strange question every day.
